context_requirements: Functional ATP-sensitive potassium channel (KATP) composed of ABCC8/SUR1 or ABCC8/SUR2 plus KCNJ11/KCNJ8 pore subunits
Expression of the sulfonylurea receptor at sufficient levels to inhibit channel activity
A cellular context where KATP channel activity or PPARG modulation produces transcriptional changes in the measured 6-24 h window
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Consistent up- or down-regulation of PPARG target genes or KATP-channel-linked genes after treatment
Shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is absent in vehicle controls
